features.name: Artemis
features.description: Root of the Artemis feature model.

features.name: Teaching and Content
features.description: Course-facing teaching, content, and communication capabilities.

features.name: Lectures
features.description: Enables lecture management with units, slides, videos, and attachments.

features.name: Tutorial Groups
features.description: Enables tutorial group management for organizing students and tutors.

features.name: Course Workflow
features.description: Core course creation, access, overview, and lifecycle workflows.

features.name: Communication
features.description: Course communication, messaging, and notification workflows.

features.name: Exercise System
features.description: Shared exercise infrastructure and supported exercise types.

features.name: Common Exercise Infrastructure
features.description: Shared creation, participation, submission, and assessment infrastructure for exercises.

features.name: Programming Exercises
features.description: Programming exercise authoring, participation, and automated assessment workflows.

features.name: Quiz Exercises
features.description: Quiz authoring, participation, and assessment workflows.

features.name: Text Exercises
features.description: Enables text exercises with manual and automated assessment capabilities.

features.name: Modeling Exercises
features.description: Enables UML diagram exercises using the Apollon editor with automatic similarity comparison.

features.name: File Upload Exercises
features.description: Enables file upload exercises for submitting documents, images, and other files.

features.name: Assessment and Integrity
features.description: Exam, assessment-support, and academic-integrity capabilities.

features.name: Exam Mode
features.description: Enables exam mode for conducting secure online assessments with proctoring features.

features.name: Plagiarism Detection
features.description: Enables plagiarism detection using JPlag for text, modeling, and programming exercises.

features.name: Athena (AI Assessment)
features.description: Enables Athena ML-based automated feedback suggestions for text and programming exercises.

features.name: Adaptive Learning and AI
features.description: Adaptive learning, tutoring, feedback, and AI-assisted capabilities.

features.name: Atlas (Adaptive Learning)
features.description: Enables competency-based learning features including learning paths, competency tracking, and analytics.

features.name: Iris (AI Assistant)
features.description: Enables the Iris AI virtual tutor powered by LLMs for personalized student support and code assistance.

features.name: Hyperion (AI Authoring)
features.description: Enables AI assistance for problem statements, quizzes, FAQs, and quiz variants.

features.name: Deimos (Malicious Participation Analysis)
features.description: Enables the Deimos module that lets instructors screen programming-exercise participations for malicious behavior using an LLM.

features.name: Platform Integrations
features.description: Authentication, external platform, editor, and sharing integrations.

features.name: LTI Integration
features.description: Enables Learning Tools Interoperability (LTI) for integration with external learning management systems.

features.name: Theia (Online IDE)
features.description: Enables the Theia cloud-based IDE for programming exercises, allowing students to code in the browser.

features.name: Apollon (Modeling)
features.description: Enables the Apollon UML modeling editor for creating and editing diagrams in modeling exercises.

features.name: Exercise Sharing
features.description: Enables sharing and importing of programming exercises between courses and institutions.

features.name: Agent Access
features.description: Allow instructors and editors to give coding agents scoped access to course content through personal access tokens and MCP.

features.name: Database
features.description: Exactly one database system backs a deployment; the alternatives are encoded by paired compose stacks.

features.name: MySQL
features.description: MySQL database alternative encoded by the paired docker/mysql.yml compose stacks.

features.name: PostgreSQL
features.description: PostgreSQL database alternative encoded by the paired docker/postgres.yml compose stacks.

features.name: CI Provider
features.description: Exactly one continuous-integration provider builds programming exercises in a deployment.

features.name: Integrated Code Lifecycle
features.description: Built-in CI provider activated by the localci and buildagent Spring profiles.

features.name: Jenkins
features.description: External Jenkins CI provider activated by the jenkins Spring profile and docker/jenkins.yml stack.

features.name: Local Version Control
features.description: Version control baseline activated by the localvc Spring profile; fixed for every deployment.

constraints.description: Apollon PDF conversion is only meaningful for modeling exercise UML models in the functional feature model.
A deployment selects exactly one option of Database; MySQL and PostgreSQL are mutually exclusive.
A deployment selects exactly one option of CI Provider; Integrated Code Lifecycle and Jenkins are mutually exclusive.
